description: Source code implementing timer functions for ARM1136 architecture, including initialization, delay, and timer reading functions.

methods.name: timer_init
methods.description: Initializes and starts the hardware timer.

methods.name: get_timer
methods.description: Returns elapsed time since a base value.

methods.name: __udelay
methods.description: Delays execution for a specified number of microseconds.

methods.name: get_timer_masked
methods.description: Returns the current timer value accounting for rollover.

methods.name: get_ticks
methods.description: Returns the current timer tick count.
